-- 1. Add verificationStatus to fleet_accounts if it doesn't exist
ALTER TABLE fleet_accounts 
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verification_status ENUM('pending','approved','rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verified_by_user_id INT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verified_at TIMESTAMP NULL;

-- 2. Create fleet_manager_requests table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fleet_manager_requests (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id INT NOT NULL,
  fleet_account_id INT NULL,
  company_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  company_reg VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  job_title VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  contact_phone VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  status ENUM('pending','approved','rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  reviewed_by_user_id INT NULL,
  reviewed_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  review_notes TEXT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_fmr_user_id (user_id),
  INDEX idx_fmr_fleet_account_id (fleet_account_id),
  INDEX idx_fmr_status (status),
  INDEX idx_fmr_created_at (created_at)
);
